rules.cap: that p90 rounded up to the next 0.05 %
rules.order: sort prints by (int(h), int(lgid)) — both fields arrive as strings
rules.organic: every print that is neither leg of a match; victims stay organic
rules.pool: (en or 'unattributed', t0a, t1a) — no pool address on a row; v3 fee tiers merge
rules.quote_to_fill: bps of a1/a0 against the previous organic print in the pool, adverse-signed: buy q/q_prev − 1, sell 1 − q/q_prev
rules.round_trip: a wallet's next print in the block is the other side, |Δa0| / a0 ≤ 5% — the same wallet buying back what it just sold
rules.route: lowest organic p90 quote-to-fill among pools with ≥ 50 organic prints
rules.sandwich: a round-trip whose legs enclose 1–4 other makers printing in leg 1's direction, with take > 0 — the prints between were front-run
